name: probe_results_merged
title: R2 probe results on merged xsub+b2 corpus (conf=clear)
description: 231 teacher-forced captures (81 xsub + 150 b2). Per (class x kind x layer): pooled + leave-one-trace-out AUROC of annotated positions vs depth-matched within-trace controls; escape-vs-reheat. Headline: cycle onset LOO 0.989-0.992 L16-19 (n=291), loop 0.975-0.978 L2-6 (n=285), muse 0.947-0.952 L16-19 (n=13). Escape-vs-reheat: loop 0.86, cycle 0.72, muse 1.0 (8v5, fragile).
caveats: Observational (teacher-forced); muse escape-vs-reheat perfect separation at n=13 is statistically weak; onset AUROCs broad across layers.
